result.narrative:
Shrivana Textile Mills is showing a clear and building pattern of payment stress rather than an isolated late payment. The working-capital (WT) policy has an oldest overdue of 50 days, and a second, separate policy (Supply Chain Finance) is now also overdue at 34 days — stress has spread beyond a single funding line. Resolution lag has been worsening over the last three cycles (10→14→22 days late) and notification volume has doubled in the latest six-month window, now spanning both policies at once.

The High Risk band (score 71.9, PD 0.7212) is driven jointly by the payment leg (50 DPD, weighted 45.5) and a severity-4 news item (weighted 26.4) describing banks reviewing their exposure to the company after it sought longer credit terms amid falling European export orders. The adjudicator agrees with the band but flags two caveats: the news story comes from a single outlet (Illustrative) with no corroborating coverage found elsewhere, and the second policy's 34 DPD overdue is a separate concern worth tracking independently of the WT line used for scoring.

The recommended action is to reduce both limits to the level where expected loss meets the 25% appetite target: the WT line from 80,000,000 to 42,000,000 INR (matching current owed exposure, cutting expected loss from 41,541,120 to 21,809,088), and the SCF line from 20,000,000 to 9,500,000 INR (expected loss falling from 10,385,280 to 4,933,008). Neither cut is constrained by a max-liability bind.

A move back to the lower Watch band would require the score to improve by 21.9 points, which would need the overdue positions to be resolved and the resolution-lag/notification trends to reverse; conversely, further deterioration on either policy's DPD, additional overdue notifications, or corroborating negative news would reinforce the current band or push risk higher.

judgement.bottom_line: Reduce both limits to the expected-loss-at-25%-appetite levels (WT: 80M→42M INR; SCF: 20M→9.5M INR); the adjudicator agrees with the High Risk band but with caveats on single-source news and spreading stress across a second policy.

Reversal of the worsening resolution-lag and notification-volume trends
worsens_it: Further increase in days past due on the WT or SCF lines
Additional overdue notifications or further spread of stress to other funding lines
Corroborating negative news on lender exposure or liquidity, which would confirm the single-sourced ILL-001 story
